facts.summary: Phase 3 missed primary PFS endpoint versus sunitinib · Phase 3 · QINLOCK (ripretinib) in second-line GIST · on market (fourth-line)

evidence.summary: The study did not meet the primary endpoint of improved progression-free survival (PFS) compared with the standard of care sunitinib.
evidence.primary_endpoint_met: The study did not achieve the primary efficacy endpoint of progression-free survival (PFS) as determined by independent radiologic review using modified Response Evaluation Criteria in Solid Tumors (RECIST).
